title: "All Day and All Night and 93 seconds."
content: I don't know where else I can put this but I drifted off and found myself at an important meeting. these words were spoken and I found it strange enough to wake myself and post them here. might be nonsense but on the other hand.. I don't have any idea what the additional 93 seconds means but I do understand time/math work differently when we're dream/sleeping. I'm almost half expecting someone at a hearing to splutter this 'time frame'.
